Before you let someone into your home to do a job, wouldn't it be nice if someone else knew exactly who, where and when too?

That's what job-sharing on Workit does — one tap sends a trusted contact the worker's name, photo and job location before it starts. It sits alongside the doorstep start code (so you know it's really them) and an SOS button on every job. Workers are ID-verified, and both sides rate each other once it's done.

Small features, real peace of mind 👉 workitsa.co.za
